actions.action: Security pack: a free new card on request and an alert for every card payment
Instant dispute credit: credit disputed card charges at once, up to $100 per customer, for 8 weeks

message: Update on the card charges from Nov 16-17: our card processor confirmed a fault that charged some payments twice, and a small number of cards had fraud test charges of $0.50 to $2 after card numbers were stolen elsewhere, for example on a fake shopping site. Cobalt's own systems were not breached. About 9,000 customers were affected. Starting today, for 8 weeks: if you dispute a card charge, we credit up to $100 right away while we investigate. In the app you can turn on an alert for every card payment and order a free new card.
why:
The week-4 facts are far smaller than the 'Cobalt got hacked' rumor, but many customers only heard the rumor.
Instant dispute credit and payment alerts give every customer a concrete way to protect themselves before the migration.
We repeat only what the processor confirmed and promise nothing about refunds we cannot yet confirm.

actions.action: Higher offline card limit during the migration

message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, 12:00 CT, Cobalt moves to a new core banking system. For those 36 hours the app is read-only: you can see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards are paused. Your card keeps working offline: we raised the limit to $250 per payment for that weekend, and we added support staff for the coming weeks. If something goes wrong the switch can take some hours longer; we will post updates in the app.
why:
PLACEHOLDER, not locked: Tell customers early and plainly what the migration weekend means.
The $250 offline limit covers most weekend card spending while transfers are paused.
Extra staff keeps support waits short after the charges scare and around the switch.
